notablePrerequisites:
Blade of the Bloodchief attached to Scurry Oak.
You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Blade of the Bloodchief triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
